mechanism: Fenofibrate may potentiate the hypertensive and serotonergic effects of tranylcypromine (an MAOI), with additional risk of lipid metabolism effects and potential for serotonin syndrome.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution under close monitoring; consider alternative antidepressant or lipid-lowering agent; monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and neuropsychiatric symptoms closely.
